MOON finished the hour up **4.41%**, from $0.6034 at 01:36 to $0.6300 at 02:36 (UTC). This is worked out from the 61 one-minute prices in `notes/moon-prices.csv`. I didn't check them against a live read.

| Change | +$0.0266 (+4.41%) | |
